formula.en: And finally, a winning formula is a method or strategy that produces successful results.
formula.zh: 最后，致胜法宝是一种产生成功结果的方法或策略。

formula.zh: 幸运的是，莎朗发现了致胜法宝——她女儿可以安全食用的东西——米饭和豆子。

formula.zh: Ramanujan寄去的公式深邃、优雅，最重要的是，它们是崭新的。

follow.en: It was also during this time that allegations of corruption began to follow him.

following.zh: 我是 Neil。我是 Becca。Neil，以下这些动物有什么共同点？

following.zh: 第二年夏天，他再次故技重施，当时他才 16 岁。

following.zh: 那么，以下哪种大蒜品种生长在前苏联？

following.zh: 布什，也就是老布什，是在副总统任期结束后直接当选总统的。

foremost.en: Gunhild Sætren First and foremost, I would say that perhaps the gender differs.
foremost.zh: Gunhild Sætren：首先，我想说，也许性别存在差异。

foremost.zh: Gunhild 说，首先，男性和女性对寒冷的感觉不同。

follower.en: This was a partial success. We reached over 20 million downloads, but only got to 600,000 Spotify followers.
follower.zh: 这是一个部分的成功。我们的下载量突破了 2000 万，但 Spotify 粉丝只达到了 60 万。

follower.en: Its key architect was a man named Edwin Chadwick, who was a follower of the philosopher Jeremy Bentham.
follower.zh: 它的主要策划者是一个名叫 Edwin Chadwick 的人，他是哲学家 Jeremy Bentham 的追随者。

follower.zh: 我的目标是 65 万 Spotify 粉丝，100,000 名 YouTube 订阅者。

follower.en: She's also the first artistic swimmer with over a million social media followers, after videos of her walking upside down underwater went viral.
follower.zh: 她也是第一位在社交媒体上拥有超过百万粉丝的花样游泳运动员，此前她倒立在水下行走的视频在网上疯传。

formal.en: Even though you are still speaking English, you’ve switched between formal and informal styles.
formal.zh: 尽管你仍然在说英语，但你已经在正式和非正式风格之间进行了切换。

formal.zh: 它也发生在英语内部正式风格和非正式风格的切换中。

formal.en: They were not organised in any formal sense, but they had numbers, and local political support.
formal.zh: 他们算不上正式的组织，但人数众多，而且在当地政界也有支持者。

formal.zh: 他并非出身于军人家庭，也谈不上接受过什么正式的军事教育。

formal.zh: 学校里的正式英语课程往往倾向于应试教育。

fossil.en: France, despite having relatively low fossil fuel reserves, is the largest energy exporter in Europe.
fossil.zh: 法国尽管化石燃料储量相对较低，却是欧洲最大的能源出口国。

fossil.en: These fossils closely resembled, looked very similar to, smaller animals still living in the region.
fossil.zh: 这些化石与该地区仍然生活着的小型动物高度相似，外形非常接近。

fossil.en: He was responsible for observing, collecting, and recording plants, animals, rocks, and fossils along the journey.
fossil.zh: 他负责在旅途中观察、收集和记录动植物、岩石以及化石。

fossil.en: Fossils are the remains of prehistoric plants or animals that have been preserved in rock for a very long time.
fossil.zh: 化石是史前植物或动物的遗骸，它们在岩石中被保存了很长时间。

fossil.en: Adam argues that only a tiny fraction – meaning a very small amount – of life on Earth has turned into fossil.

fountain.en: Some even had perfume fountains at their extravagant banquets, spraying scented mist over their guests.

fountain.en: Fountains in Versailles were filled with orange blossom water, and royal furniture was sprayed with lavender and rose extracts.
fountain.zh: 凡尔赛宫的喷泉里注满了橙花水，皇家家具上喷洒了薰衣草和玫瑰提取物。

fountain.en: MyPolis runs council assemblies where children can propose improvements to their local school community – anything from fixing broken water fountains to changing the curriculum.

foundation.en: And Marie Curie… her discoveries laid the foundations for so many other things.
foundation.zh: 而玛丽·居里……她的发现为如此之多的其他领域奠定了基础。

foreigner.en: But, in the eyes of the law, they're not; they are foreigners.
foreigner.zh: 但是，在法律眼中，他们不是；他们是外国人。

fold.en: And the good news is that AI is getting much more energy-efficient, with that Google study reporting that energy use for each query is now 3% of what it was a year ago, a 33-fold reduction.

formidable.en: And it would be in the Iberian Peninsula–in modern day Spain–that he would learn the skills that turned him into such a formidable military commander.
formidable.zh: 正是在伊比利亚半岛——也就是今天的西班牙——他学会了让他成长为一名令人生畏的军事统帅的各种技能。

fortune.en: Some oligarchs, like Roman Abramovich, struck deals with Putin, pledging their loyalty in exchange for keeping their fortunes.
fortune.zh: 一些寡头，比如罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇，与普京达成了协议，宣誓效忠以换取保留他们的财富。

fortune.en: He arrived in Rabat as a disgraced former leader, his entourage vastly reduced, his fortune frozen or looted.
fortune.zh: 他以一个失势的前领导人身份抵达拉巴特，随行人员寥寥无几，财富被冻结或遭洗劫。

fortune.en: Exploration was the ultimate frontier, and it promised fortune, glory, and the chance to write your name into history.
fortune.zh: 探索是终极的前沿，它承诺带来财富、荣耀，以及将你的名字写入历史的机会。

fortune.en: We’ll explore how the city built its fortunes based on gold and coffee, and the how the city has developed in the modern period.
fortune.zh: 我们将探讨这座城市是如何靠黄金和咖啡发家致富的，以及它在现代时期的发展历程。

fortune.en: Well, you could, of course, sit around playing cards, drinking port, and gambling your family’s fortune away, as it seemed Percy Fawcett’s father did.
fortune.zh: 嗯，你当然可以闲坐着打牌、喝波特酒，把家族的财富挥霍一空，看起来 Percy Fawcett 的父亲就是这么做的。

fortunate.en: I was fortunate because maybe I had a bit more time, personal time to study than my other classmates.
fortunate.zh: 我很幸运，因为比起其他同学，我可能有更多的个人时间用来学习。

fortunate.en: Others, like Mikhail Khodorkovsky, were less fortunate.
fortunate.zh: 另一些人，比如米哈伊尔·霍多尔夫斯基，则没有那么幸运。

forge.en: These elements were created during supernova explosions and collisions of neutron stars—cosmic events that forge the universe’s heaviest and most valuable materials.
forge.zh: 这些元素是在超新星爆炸和中子星碰撞过程中产生的——这些宇宙事件锻造出了宇宙中最重、最有价值的物质。

forge.en: But, fortunately, the craft had been forged from incredibly strong steel, and the men successfully went to the depths of the Mariana trench and returned alive and well.
forge.zh: 但幸运的是，这艘飞船是用极其坚固的钢材锻造的，这两个人成功地潜入了马里亚纳海沟的深处，并活着健康地返回了。

footstep.en: Just as candidates on ‘The Apprentice’ competed to learn from Trump and follow in his footsteps, JD Vance is seen as the political apprentice set to continue the movement that Trump started.
footstep.zh: 正如《学徒》节目中的候选人竞争向Trump学习并追随他的脚步一样，JD Vance被视为将延续Trump所发起的政治运动的政治学徒。

fortress.en: Rather than being one continuous wall, it’s probably better to think about the Great Wall as a network of different walls and watchtowers and fortresses and defensive barriers which stretch all across northern China.
fortress.zh: 与其说长城是一堵连绵不断的墙，不如把它想象成由各种城墙、瞭望塔、堡垒和防御工事组成的网络，绵延整个中国北方。
